_help: Owner data for the legal pages (docs/legal) and /.well-known/security.txt. Fill in every empty value before publishing; empty values are shown as highlighted [placeholders]. Build with LEGAL_STRICT=1 to fail while any remains. See docs/legal/README.md.

owner._help: Titular of the website (LSSI-CE art. 10) and data controller (GDPR art. 13.1.a): a person, company, school or public body.

dpo._help: Data Protection Officer (GDPR arts. 37-39, LOPDGDD art. 34). Mandatory for public bodies and schools; leave both empty if none is designated and the paragraph is left out.

hosting._help: Who serves the static files. Defaults describe GitHub Pages; change them for a school or Consellería server.

accessibility._help: Accessibility statement (RD 1112/2018). status: 'partial' until an audit says otherwise ('full' or 'none' are the other values).

security._help: security.txt (RFC 9116). contact: a mailto: or https: URI. expires: ISO date; empty = build date + 180 days.
